operating_notes.text: Received an Administrative Warning Letter dated April 30, 2026, from SEBI for delayed disclosure of arbitration and settlement with Hindustan Copper Limited.
Madras High Court modified interim attachment order on 30.04.2026 allowing bank appropriation of ₹15.69 Cr and SEPC salary utilization of ₹2 Cr.
Approved conversion of 24,236,652 partly paid equity shares to fully paid shares out of 49,291,505 shares issued call notices.
SEPC-Furlong JV secured an EPC sub-contract from Shalimar Corp Limited for road widening in Uttar Pradesh worth ₹521.46 crore.
MOIL Limited cancelled the ₹230 Cr turnkey work order for designing and constructing the 3rd Vertical Shaft with nil execution and forfeited ₹50 Lakhs EMD.
Monitoring agency report for Q4FY26 showed gross proceeds received of ₹324.94 Cr and cumulative utilization of ₹311.11 Cr.
FY26 consolidated revenue reached ₹1,054.50 Cr and net profit rose to ₹53.54 Cr.
FY26 total revenue reached ₹1,085.84 Cr and net profit rose to ₹53.54 Cr with an order book around ₹10,000 Cr.
Received intimations rescinding seven rural water supply project agreements in Jharkhand awarded between 2016 and 2023.
Received interim stay from the Hon'ble High Court of Jharkhand on the rescission of seven rural water supply contracts till next hearing on November 30, 2026.

timeline.summary: Mark AB Capital Investment LLC, Mark AB Welfare Trust, and Mark AB Capital Private Limited declared no encumbrances on SEPC Limited shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
SEPC received an administrative warning letter from SEBI regarding delayed disclosure of arbitration and settlement with Hindustan Copper Limited.
Madras High Court issued interim directions permitting bank appropriation of ₹15.69 Cr from TRA and allowing SEPC ₹2 Cr for salaries.
SEPC approved the conversion of 2.42 Cr partly paid-up equity shares into fully paid-up shares following receipt of final call money.
SEPC announced that its joint operation SEPC-Furlong JV won an EPC sub-contract worth ₹521.46 crore from Shalimar Corp Limited for road widening in Uttar Pradesh.
MOIL Limited cancelled SEPC's ₹230 Cr turnkey work order for the 3rd Vertical Shaft and forfeited ₹50 Lakhs EMD.
SEPC resubmitted its disclosure on May 22, 2026, regarding an administrative warning letter received from SEBI on April 30, 2026.
SEPC filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, confirming ₹311.11 Cr utilization.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹273.83 Cr (+132.5% YoY), net profit ₹13.73 Cr (+37.0% YoY).
SEPC reported FY26 consolidated total revenue of ₹1,085.84 crore and net profit of ₹53.54 crore.
Jharkhand state government rescinded seven ongoing rural water supply project contracts awarded to SEPC between 2016 and 2023.
SEPC obtained an interim stay from the Jharkhand High Court on October 27, 2026, halting the rescission of seven rural water supply contracts until November 30, 2026.

upcoming_events.description: Madras High Court hearing in E.P. No. 91 of 2023 matter
Next hearing at Hon'ble High Court of Jharkhand regarding water supply contracts rescission stay
